response.overview: Shane starts this one off by bringing me back some footage from her river trip. After seeing what went on, I can guarantee that I will not miss the next one! I met Diva (with the help of two little friends) at the park near my house. I introduced myself, and she had actually seen some of my movies. Next thing I know, she’s sucking and fucking in my house, on camera!! Life is great! As so was Diva!! Next, Shane and Rosie demonstrate what their bachelor parties are like. WOW!! I have a gut feeling there is going to be a sharp increase of marriage proposals this year! Finally I invite my brother and my buddy Butch over to watch the football game. When we get to the house we find out Shane had made different plans with Tabitha and Sophie. The “game” ended up in my living room floor and culminates when Butch turns our two ‘tight ends’ into ‘wide receivers’, if you know what I mean. Enjoy…I did. Seymore.
response.title: Seymore Butts' Goes Nuts
